datasets.name: ClientTypes
datasets.sql:
SELECT rowid,id,category,custategory,rezcategory,valcategory
  FROM dm_categories where custategory=:custcategory and rezcategory=:rezcategory and valcategory=:valcategory

datasets.name: Customers
datasets.sql:
select rowid,id,name,nerezident,cust_type, case when
nvl(cust_type,0)=0 then ' Hüquqi ' else   ' Fiziki ' end custtype_name from customers where id=:custid and close_dat is  null and cust_type<>4

datasets.name: DepCapperiod
datasets.sql:
select 
   id,
   period,
   description||'('||(select withdrtypedesc from dm_addtypes where withdrtype=type#)||')' as description,
   periodid 
from 
  dm_depcapitalperiods
where 
   periodid = :periodid
order by period

datasets.name: DepPeriods
datasets.sql:
select id,period,description,depid,period_type from dm_depperiods

where depid = :depid
order by period

datasets.name: usrs
datasets.sql: select id,lower(name) as name from smart.user$

datasets.name: DmDepositPerSettings
datasets.sql:
select c.rowid,c.* from dm_depositpersettings c where c.depid=:depid and c.periodid=:periodid and c.capitalid=:capitalid and c.currencyid=:currencyid
and firstamount<=:amount and lastamount>=:amount

datasets.name: DmProlanqasiya
datasets.sql:
select 0 id,'Olunmasın' name from dual
union
select 1 id,'Olunsun' name from dual

datasets.name: DepositPorps
datasets.sql:
select cont.rowid,
       cont.id,
       cont.opendate, 
       cont.closedate, 
       cont.amount, 
       cont.contractno, 
       cont.contracttype,
       cont.clienttype,
       cont.sid#, 
       cont.branchid,
       cont.currency, 
       cont.personaltype,
       cont.customerid,
       cont.capitalperid,
       cont.periodid,
       cont.interest,
       cont.overdueinterest,
       cont.dueinterest,
       cont.firstinterestpaydat,
       cont.prolanid,
       cont.tocard,
       cont.agentid,
       cont.personsid,
       cont.prizeid,
       cont.deppersetid,
       cont.bonusstatus
     
from   
   dm_contracts cont
  
where 
      cont.id = :ContractID

datasets.name: CreditContractno
datasets.sql:
select 
   creditid,
   numberofcredit,
   boorowerid,
   dateofconclusion,
   duedatefirstcontract,
   creditlineamount,
   annualyinterestrate,
   rest,
   interestrest,
   branchid
from 
  cm_portfolio p,
  cm_curr_state s 
where 
   p.id=s.creditid
 and
   instr(p.depozitids,:contractid)>0

datasets.name: DmContractType
datasets.sql:
select * from dm_contract_type
order by topid
